---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Johnoel <joh...@hawaii.edu>
Date: Mon, Jul 13, 2020 at 10:05 PM
Subject: [Developers] Fwd: FW: Announcement: 23rd EuroAD / 1st Virtual AD Workshop
To: ADMB Users <us...@admb-project.org>, <devel...@admb-project.org>



 

From: Hueckelheim, Jan Christian <jhueck...@anl.gov>
Sent: Monday, July 13, 2020 9:30 AM
To: Hueckelheim, Jan Christian <jhueck...@anl.gov>
Subject: Announcement: 23rd EuroAD / 1st Virtual AD Workshop

 

Dear colleagues,

 

we are excited to announce the

23rd European Workshop on Automatic Differentiation (EuroAD), to be held as

the First Virtual, Worldwide Workshop on Automatic Differentiation,

on August 11-13, 2020

 

Registration for this workshop is now fully open and free of charge before the deadline.

 

Topics include, but are not limited to

 - theoretical developments in Automatic/Algorithmic Differentiation, autodiff, back-propagation and related methods,

 - applications thereof,

 - implementation of AD tools, libraries, languages and language features, and

 - problems and challenges for the development and use of AD.

 

Presentations on work in progress, possible new directions, open questions, as well as completed work are welcome.

We encourage PhD students and those new to the field to attend and present their work.

 

Please register at http://www.autodiff.org if you want to attend the workshop.

The registration deadline is on Friday 7 August 2020 (or when capacity limits are reached).

The deadline for talk submission is on Sunday 26 July 2020 23:59 AOE. Presenters will be notified by 28 July 2020.

 

Please share this email with colleagues who may be interested in this workshop.

 

We look forward to seeing you.

Paul Hovland

Jan Hückelheim

Sri Hari Krishna Narayanan

Michel Schanen
